messages.「炎蝶の棺」を30まで溜めて強化S3を撃ち、守備から出す「正午の解体」で戦闘感覚: A Burn and Tremor attacker that builds Fire Butterfly Coffin to 30 for enhanced S3. Her full cycle begins after using Dismemberment at High Noon through defense to gain 3 Combat Instinct and a large heal; passive Coffin generation then lets her keep using enhanced S3 regularly.
messages.炎蝶の棺: 最大30(1ターンに得られるのは最大20)。基本スキルの的中で2、各: **Fire Butterfly Coffin**: Maximum 30, with at most 20 gained per turn. Landing a basic skill grants 2, and each skill also adds more on use. Every 10 increases Clash Power and reuse Coins. If it exceeds 20 at Turn End, she gains half of the excess as Burn next turn (5 Burn and +2 Burn Count at 30).
messages.「正午の解体」(守備「烙印」から): 棺30以上で変化する広域乱射(1ターン1回: **Dismemberment at High Noon (from the Defense skill Stigmatize)**: An Unfocused Volley that it turns into at 30 or more Coffin, once per turn. After the attack, she spends up to 30 of her own Burn and recovers (5/20 + Burn spent)% of her max HP, up to 35/50%. She then spends all Coffin and gains 3 Battle Instinct. It does not transform while she has Overheated Coffin.
messages.戦闘感覚: 最大3。速度の最小・最大値+2、基本スキルで付与する火傷の威力・回数: **Battle Instinct**: Maximum 3. +2 to minimum and maximum Speed, +1 to the Burn Potency and Count inflicted by basic skills, and more damage for skills such as Eject and Eject - High Noon.
messages.バトルパッシブ「フォイヤファルター[スティグマ工房]」(憤怒×3・保有・同期化Ⅱ: **Combat passive — Feuerfalter [Stigma Workshop] (3 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: With Battle Instinct, gains (value×3) Coffin at Combat Start, or 9 at 3 Battle Instinct. She follows up with Seconded Offensive after certain skills from Sinclair's Dawn Office Fixer and Gregor's Dawn Office Rep, or when their basic skills stagger an enemy.
messages.「射出-正午」(S3「射出」から): 棺30で変化する広域乱射(1ターン1回)。: **Eject - High Noon (from S3 Eject)**: An Unfocused Volley that it turns into at 30 Coffin, once per turn. All Coins are Unbreakable Coins. It performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Scorch and triggers Tremor Burst, then grants 1 Battle Instinct and 1 Overheated Coffin after the attack. It does not spend Coffin.
messages.断熱コート: 火傷ダメージでは混乱せず、体力も1未満にならない。火傷による被ダメ: **Heatproof Coat**: Burn damage does not stagger her and cannot reduce her HP below 1. Damage taken from Burn is reduced by 50%, or 75% below 50% HP.
messages.序盤は棺10未満のスキルが弱いので、慎重に動きながら棺を溜める。S3「射出」と守: Her skills are weak below 10 Coffin early on, so build Coffin while playing carefully. S3 Eject and the Defense skill Stigmatize gain Coffin and Wrath, so they are fine to use from the start. Once she reaches 30 Coffin, fire Eject - High Noon first if S3 is in hand. Then fire Dismemberment at High Noon from her Defense skill to gain 3 Battle Instinct and recover HP. However, on the turn she fires Eject - High Noon, Overheated Coffin prevents her Defense skill from transforming, so be careful when acting with multiple slots. After gaining 3 Battle Instinct, she gains 9 Coffin every turn and can fire the enhanced S3 repeatedly. Above 20 Coffin she starts damaging herself, so if her HP is under pressure, recover early with Dismemberment at High Noon. Pairing her with the other two Dawn Office members adds Seconded Offensive follow-ups.
